description: This file defines the SugarPHPMailer class, a custom extension of the PHPMailer class used in SuiteCRM. It provides methods for configuring email sending functionalities, including handling SMTP, OAuth, attachments, embedded images, and email content customization. The class is integral for email operations within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SugarPHPMailer
classes.description: A customized extension of PHPMailer for SuiteCRM, handling email configuration, placement, attachments, embedded images, OAuth authentication, and logging for email activities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarPHPMailer object, setting default configurations and loading email settings.

methods.name: setMailer
methods.description: Prepares the mailer object with user-specific SMTP or sendmail settings.

methods.name: setSystemFromAddress
methods.description: Sets the system default 'From' email address and name.

methods.name: setMailerForSystem
methods.description: Prepares the mailer object with system-wide email settings.

methods.name: initSMTPAuth
methods.description: Configures SMTP authentication based on selected auth type (basic or oauth).

methods.name: initOAuth
methods.description: Sets up OAuth2 authentication for SMTP using external OAuth connection data.

methods.name: prepForOutbound
methods.description: Prepares email content, including charset conversions, disclosures, and HTML formatting, for outbound sending.

methods.name: replaceImageByRegex
methods.description: Replaces image URLs in email body with CID references and attaches embedded images.

methods.name: handleAttachments
methods.description: Attaches files or notes to the email, replacing image URLs with embedded images.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during email processing.

methods.name: smtpConnect
methods.description: Attempts SMTP connection with optional error logging.

methods.name: PreSend
methods.description: Ensures email body is not empty before sending.

methods.name: embeddedAttachmentExists
methods.description: Checks if an embedded attachment already exists to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces template variables in email subjects and bodies.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Overrides PHPMailer send to include detailed SMTP debugging and error handling.

methods.name: setSecureProtocol
methods.description: Sets the security protocol (SSL/TLS) for SMTP connection.
